json.reply: Psst. Up here, in the case marked 'Viennese Gentleman'; I have been a very convincing exhibit since noon. The second movement starts in four minutes and I cannot let you into it without my cue sheet, which I dropped beside that dreadful grouse. Fetch it, and when the cellos swell at bar ninety, walk as loudly as you like.
options: Which grouse? They are all dreadful.
Why does the cellist matter so much?
Are you going to get out of that case?

actions.title: The Dropped Cue
actions.description: Haberl dropped his cue sheet near a guarded specimen in the gallery. Without it, nobody knows the bar to step into the music.
